newsitem.title: USA: TriMas completes redemption of debentures.
newsitem.headline: TriMas completes redemption of debentures.

text.p: TriMas Corp said Friday it has completed the redemption of the remaining portion of its $115 million in five percent convertible subordinated debentures due 2003.

The company said it had fixed March 21 as the date for early redemption. Prior to that, $106 million or 92 percent was converted into 4.7 million shares of TriMas at the conversion price of $22-5/8 a share. On Friday, $9 million or eight percent were redeemed for cash.
Share outstanding of TriMas now total 41.3 million, the company said. Funding for the redemption came from the company's available cash resources.
TriMas is a diversified proprietary products company.
